item.title: “Pesach Cleaning Isn’t Spring Cleaning”
item.description: In a video shared this week, San Antonio Shliach Rabbi Chaim Block explained what the meaning of Pesach cleaning is, and shared a story that led to a revelation by the moderator.

item.title: Preparations for 11 Nissan Parade in Florida Underway
item.description: In honor of Yud Alef Nissan, a Mitzvah Tank Parade will depart from the Lubavitch Educational Center (LEC) to drive through Miami and disperse to various mivtzoim locations to distribute Shmurah Matzah and help Yidden with Tefillin.

item.title: L'Chaim: Rotenberg - Blesofsky
item.description: The L'Chaim of Naftali Rotenberg of Crown Heights and Mushka Blesofsky of Iowa City, IA took place at the Jewish Children’s Museum in Crown Heights.

item.title: New Single Features the Story of Elisha and the Widow
item.description: Singer/songwriter Shlomo Gleyzer has released a stirring new song titled Elisha, inspired by the well-known story in Sefer Melachim II (4:1-7) of the widow who cries out to the prophet Elisha and is saved through the miracle of oil.

item.title: You Can Win: A Living Thread
item.description: A piece of fabric from the dress of the Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka a"h will be given to one person who gives to The Space — a home for Jewish women and girls to grow, connect, and thrive.

item.title: Farbrengen at 770 Celebrates Rebbe’s Birthday
item.description: A joyous Farbrengen celebrated Yud Alef Nissan - the Rebbe's 124th birthday at 770 Eastern Parkway on Motzei Shabbos.

item.title: Friendship Circle's L.A. Chai Concert Draws 1,500
item.description: The Los Angeles Jewish community came together in powerful fashion for “L.A. CHAI,” a landmark concert organized by Chabad of the Valley that seamlessly blended world-class Jewish music with celebrating the life-changing work of the Friendship Circle and commemorating the 10th yahrtzeit of Rabbi Joshua B. Gordon obm.

item.title: Hosting a Seder in a City Without Cars
item.description: Watch: Shlucha Shachar Banin of Venice, Italy, speaks about welcoming thousands of visitors to the world's first ghetto and organizing its annual Seders.

item.title: Picture of the Day
item.description: Rock singer Perry Farrell, born Peretz Bernstein, put on tefillin during a visit to 770 Eastern Parkway, meeting Rabbi Mendy Kotlarsky of Merkos 302 and Rabbi Levi Raskin of the Moshiach Office.

item.title: Barak Grossberg Covers Zusha Hit
item.description: The Chabad singer and guitarist Barak Grossberg performs a cover of the great hit of the New York band Zusha in a video clip from a live session with the band.

item.title: Congressman Issues Proclamations to 11 Chabads
item.description: U.S. Congressman Mike Lawler issued proclamations in honor of the Rebbe's birthday and sent them to the 11 Chabad centers in his congressional district.

item.title: L'Chaim: Kahan - Finkelman
item.description: The L'Chaim of Ushi Kahan of Crown Heights and Sarale Finkelman of Manhattan Beach, NY took place at Lubavitch Yeshiva Hall in Crown Heights.

item.title: The Questions I Don't Let Myself Ask
item.description: Hindel Swerdlov writes about a single day: Helping a newborn, visiting a friend battling illness, sirens amid Pesach preparations and the levaya of Sergeant Moshe Katz.

item.title: 770 Shul Cleaned Out for Pesach
item.description: The main shul of 770 Eastern Parkway was closed on Monday as it undergoes a clearing out and deep cleaning for Pesach.

item.title: What it Was Like Behind the Rebbe’s Dollar Lines
item.description: Behind the Dollar Lines: Mrs. Simcha Bracha Gitlin Shares Her Story for the First Time on The Sisters Chat.
